verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs describe a call history view with performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data, so a founder gets some built-in visibility into calls without building their own. Call summaries and custom extraction categories can capture call outcomes, but these are configured per agent and pushed out via webhooks or CRM rather than shown as aggregated dashboards. Missing for 10: explicit success-rate and duration dashboards, any sentiment analytics, aggregated outcome reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
